title: Manage Business Central Synchronization with Microsoft Fabric

facts.text: Production-ready preview planned to become available in October 2026. Delivery timing and functionality might change. Subject to supplemental terms of use.
MS Fabric Mirroring - Admin permission set: set up connection, select companies and tables, manage packages, control synchronization, and view monitoring.
MS Fabric Mirroring - Activate permission set: activate, deactivate, and reapply configuration packages.
MS Fabric Mirroring - Read permission set: view synchronization overview and detail information.
Open Microsoft Fabric Mirroring Setup page, select Configuration, then Companies, then Add company, and select a company to synchronize.
Open Microsoft Fabric Mirroring Setup page, select Configuration, then Tables, select Add table, and select one or more Business Central tables. Up to 1,000 tables allowed.
Configuration packages provide curated table sets. MS-STD package contains 256 standard Business Central tables for analytics. Activate, deactivate, or reapply packages from Import/Export…
Activating or reapplying a package cannot increase total selection beyond 1,000-table limit.
